notes.title: Patch v. 1.12
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29675999/cdba1bd4426b7c67bd1419d915e921e30e7b6a8b.png[/img]

[h1][b][u]Patch v. 1.12[/u][/b][/h1]

[u][b]Bugs:[/b][/u]

 - [spoiler] Nuchal: player now stops playing Anxiety sounds after 'collapsing lungs' (this was the intended behavior, but apparently didn't work properly)[/spoiler]
- 'Event Pickups' (postal notes etc.) now have bigger pickup trigger (was a bug related to this)
 - [spoiler] Dejavu: Fake 'Game Over' text had Blood background disabled for some reason[/spoiler]
- Oneironaut (ship): Player won't be pushed away while locked in "fixing pipes mode"


[u][b]Fixes:[/b][/u]

 - Removed weapon sprite as default when loading levels (else you see player unequip torch at start)
- Fixed a lighter background to some poems in the Poem Book (black text got lighter background for readability)
- New 'Hurt' visualization (not just linear graying) Goes gray after 50% HP and higher Contrast
- Spelling: Main Menu New Game Popup (re-worded and fixed "it's" to "its")
- Spelling: Tavern Ulrich ("contempt" to "content")
- "Black Fade-in" now fades out if player pauses the game as well (otherwise pause menu -> darker)
- Enemy 'Crawler': Missed often, now fixed
- Added "confirm" on Game Over
- 'Event Pickups' (postal notes etc.) can now be exited with ESC
- Added "Pickup" to 'Event Pickups' (postal notes etc.)
- Crosshair now centered (was a bit dropped down before, by design) Bugs caused: player to shoot slighly above target when "zoomed" 


[u][b]Level Specific:[/b][/u]

- Feed Me Drown Me: Updated Meat and Steak Count to better represent the players goal
- Feed Me Drown Me: updated ovens trigger range a bit
- Feed Me Drown Me: The wine cannon now stops shooting (breaks down) when player is done filling the wine barrel
- Losing Control: Cultist have bigger head hitbox
- Losing Control: Sniper range increased (was unable to hit targets way back)
- Current Events: Floating blocks re-placed to make it easier and more appealing 

- Oneironaut 3 (Strange World): Removed music, now only plays ambience (eery)
- Oneironaut 3 (Strange World): New lighting + Fog 
- Oneironaut 3 (Strange World): New SFX in 'drop' event
 - [spoiler]Asylum: Sfx for Locked door. New Sfx for roof opening. Sfx for door pushed[/spoiler]
 - [spoiler]Asylum: Tweaked Roof Opening, slower and with new sound for better effect [/spoiler]
- Unexpected: Doggo now has a "received bunny" sprite


[u][b]Other:[/b][/u]

- Updated "intro text" with sub context (enclosed universe)
- Updated 'Splash Screen' with new vectorized Doomster (Entertainment) Logo
- Updated Poem "Oneironaut 1" to a new version, to better explain the story (old one is removed) (In Poem book: D's Poems: 23/32) 

[u][b]Small Update Patches:[/b][/u]

- 9th November 2019: bigger exit trigger in Current Events (Low FPS could miss the trigger) 
- 12th November 2019: moved player "use" trigger up a bit (with new crosshair pos)
- 12th November 2019: hide crosshair in dialogue

notes.title: Update v. 1.1 Out now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29675999/d2408827869e59b6f9148dd2852c82974825f119.png[/img]

[h1] PATCH v. 1.1[/h1]
  

[h1]FEATURES[/h1]

  [b]- New Special Menu: (after completing the game )[/b]
    -> Level Select: can select level (achievements disabled)
    -> Poems: read all unlocked poems so far (both Rat's and D's)
    
  - Added new things to the Airship level (goats, whale, birds)
  - New decals for torch, bullet, axe impacts
  
    [b]- New Options: [/b]
      -> Anti-nausea = previously set in New Game
      -> Decal-limit = sets how many bullet / blood decals to be saved in level
      -> Ultragore = previously set in New Game (after game completion)
      -> Invert-scroll dir = Direction to cycle weapons with scrollwheel
  
  
[h1]BUGS[/h1]
  
    - Fixed a problem with "light puzzle" links flickering on high FPS
    - Fixed Jack-Daw scale problem when walking
    - Fixed: Rathugs could sometimes hit themselves when shooting
    

[h1]POLISH[/h1]
  
    - New Main Menu (logo, cover, layout)
    - fixed some spelling errors (it's -> its)
    - Updated airship speed
    - Updated raft speed to be fps independent in Current Events
    - Updated light in Current Events, Confronting Discomfort, Feed Me Drown Me, Losing Control.
    - Updated torch flicker effect
    - Fixed better hitboxes for enemies
    - Updated Decal materials (axe, bullet holes) to be affected by light better.
    - New pulsating light for Exit Portals, Fireplaces
    
    [b]- Updated the "Death_P2" (Beginning, floating orbs): [/b] 
      -> Fisheye when collecting orbs
      -> Faster at start > slower the more you grow
      -> Now attracts other nodes as you grow
      
    [b]- Space Shooter: [/b]  
      -> Updated speed on player
      -> Made Asteroides easier to break (-1hp)
      
     - Turned down "noise & scratches" in menus
     - Updated D's: dialogue choice to not force you to pick "God is everything"
     - Updated Launcher picture
     - Updated "Pacifist" bird symbol in Pause Menu with titles "Pacifist" or "Warmonger"
    [spoiler] - D changes name to Daniel in final dialogues[/spoiler]
  
  
[h1]PERFORMANCE[/h1]
  
    - Overall performance update (re-written performance-heavy code)
    - Removed tree-crown animations
    - Changed / removed some lights in a few levels
    - Performance Update in Confronting Discomfort
    - Brought down shadow distance from 100 to 80 on "Good V-sync" settings
    - Updated Music-Syncing with new lighter code
    
    + much more things (almost complete overhaul of all code and asset loading)
    
  
[h1]OTHER[/h1]
  
    - Ending monologue can be stepped forward with mouse button
    - Lower volume on blood vessel-break in Nuchal
    - Removed Unity's built-in "hardware analytics" (for crash-reports) (was never active or used, but is completely removed now)
    - Made the "Dood! That Was Rood!" (Reach The 2nd floor of Confronting Discomfort) Achievement a bit easier
    - Longer Game Over cooldown (could accidentally insta-skip it)
    - Made first intro poem skippable (mousclick fast forwards the animation)
    
    
 [i]+ probably more, touched up on almost everything :) if new bugs were introduced, report them in the Bug Forum[/i]

notes.title: Patch Save State Bug 2
notes.content:
13 Aug 2018:

- Fixed: New Save State bug: you could be back to first mission in Lobby instead of where you left off (only those who got last patch in the middle of a playthrough). It is fixed for future playthoughs now, however those who got reset will be moved to approximately the same level they left off earlier (might need to replay last mission in some cases)

notes.title: Patch 11 August 2018
notes.content:
PATCH (Windows Only) :ohnobug:

- Fixed: Savestate bug that sometimes forgot you had weapons / items (progression blocker)

- Fixed: Stuck behind bush in Current_Events

(- Fixed: a new bug appeared where you could bring a gun into the Lobby.. hence the double patch)

- Added: a "Skip Transition Poems" function (only between levels, not in the begining part) (Press ESC when text loads between levels to skip the poem) (speedrun purposes mostly)

- Added: "Restart Chapter" function. (Press P in pause menu) (Only works up til a point [spoiler] where going back to the lobby isn't possible anymore [/spoiler] )


Did a complete overhaul of save-state system, a lot of bugs came from that, so I think I've ironed them out, but if you find any, post in the Bug Discussion.
